BDB134 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB136

אֶ֫דֶר noun [masculine]

1. glory, magnificence (Assyrian aduru, adiru) ironical of price of shepherd (symbolic) Zech 11:13.
2. mangle, cloak (as wide) Mic 2:8 (|| שַׂלְמָה), but read אדרת (ת lost before following ת), so WRSProph 427.
